mapper.select:
/* com.portal.user.banner.BannerMapper.selectBannerListTotCnt */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS totcnt FROM LETTNBANNER WHERE 1 = 1
AND BANNER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

/* com.portal.user.banner.BannerMapper.selectBanner */ SELECT BANNER_ID, BANNER_NM, LINK_URL, BANNER_IMAGE, BANNER_IMAGE_FILE, BANNER_DC, SORT_ORDR, REFLCT_AT, FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM FROM LETTNBANNER WHERE BANNER_ID = #{bannerId}
mapper.insert: /* com.portal.user.banner.BannerMapper.insertBanner */ INSERT INTO LETTNBANNER ( BANNER_ID, BANNER_NM, LINK_URL, BANNER_IMAGE, BANNER_IMAGE_FILE, BANNER_DC, SORT_ORDR, REFLCT_AT, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ) VALUES ( #{bannerId}, #{bannerNm}, #{linkUrl}, #{bannerImage}, #{bannerImageFile}, #{bannerDc}, #{sortOrdr}, #{reflctAt}, #{userId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: /* com.portal.user.banner.BannerMapper.selectBannerResult */ SELECT BANNER_IMAGE_FILE, LINK_URL FROM LETTNBANNER WHERE REFLCT_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDR ASC

/* com.portal.user.banner.BannerFile */ SELECT b.FILE_STRE_COURS AS FILE_STRE_COURS, b.STRE_FILE_NM AS STRE_FILE_NM FROM LETTNBANNER a INNER JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL b ON a.BANNER_IMAGE_FILE = b.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE a.BANNER_ID = #{bannerId}
